attribution_limitations: C-reactive protein 23 is printed as mg/L in the narrative and as mg/dl in Table I.

The Discussion says the response to amphotericin B plateaued with no further progress (limited, nonsustained improvement), while the Conclusion calls the improvement marked; the comparison paragraph also says the patient showed poor clinical improvement despite similar therapy.

The phrase "since 2022" ends the presenting sentence that lists the five findings; it is kept as the time of each finding in that sentence, but the site of the "infiltration" listed after bilateral auricular edema is not stated.

Doses, schedule, number of sessions, dates and treating setting are not given for cryotherapy, antimonial therapy or amphotericin B; the timing of the clinic visit relative to the earlier treatments is not stated.
Discussion sentences about published Ethiopian cases, New World species and general amphotericin B experience describe other patients or literature, not this patient.
